Subject: Request: short-term pilot stipend while PO clears

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. We’re excited about the progress your team has made with the sandbox and the initial integration work. I understand procurement is still working through the PO and that could take another week or so.

To avoid interrupting the evaluation and to make sure your engineers can finish the final test cases, would Mediq be open to a short, 7-day pilot stipend from Redwood while the PO clears? It would be a temporary token top-up tied to the current pilot scope only (no additional services). If that works, we can issue a small access voucher and update it in HubSpot so your procurement team has the trail.

I’ve attached last week’s usage summary and a placeholder PO file to help with your internal approvals.

Proposed ask: 7 days of supplemental credits, limited to 20k input tokens / 10k output tokens (per trial).

If you want, I can loop in Ben to approve the credit and Neha can set the voucher.

Next steps: Please confirm you want the stipend and whether procurement needs any paperwork from our side.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Hi Grace —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the offer. Procurement is indeed still reviewing the PO (vendor onboarding has an extra checkbox this quarter). A short stipend would be very helpful so our mobile team can finish the real-device tests we discussed.

Two quick asks from our side:
- Can the stipend be limited to the pilot project id MEDIQ-PILOT-4521 and be non-refundable?
- Can Redwood provide a one-page confirmation we can attach to the PO file that describes the stipend scope and dates?

If you can confirm those two items we’ll accept the top-up and I’ll flag it so procurement treats it as a temporary concession rather than a separate purchase.

Thanks,
Olivia Barnes
